review_status: maintained engineering baseline; release review required
notice: Controls and tests reduce risk but do not qualify PySFMEA for certification credit or prove completeness on unseen repositories.

failure_modes.failure_mode: A relevant source or supporting artifact is silently omitted.
failure_modes.trigger: Exclusion, symlink, size, permission, path, or file-count boundary is encountered.
effects: A reviewer may overestimate analysis coverage.
failure_modes.residual_risk: Unsupported formats and dynamic/generated material still require project-specific analyzers or explicit manual review.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Python syntax is parsed incorrectly or a parse failure is represented as analyzed.
failure_modes.trigger: Unsupported syntax, encoding, malformed source, or parser-version difference.
effects: Components and source evidence may be missing or incorrectly localized.
failure_modes.residual_risk: AST analysis cannot resolve runtime metaprogramming or interpreter-specific behavior.

failure_modes.failure_mode: A credible failure mode is missed or an irrelevant candidate is generated.
failure_modes.trigger: Rule coverage, source pattern, framework, or project domain differs from the validation corpus.
effects: False positives consume engineering review effort.
failure_modes.residual_risk: Real-world recall and precision are unknown outside curated cases; qualified review remains mandatory.

failure_modes.function: Maintain identity and review state across rescans
failure_modes.failure_mode: A review is attached to the wrong element or remains valid after a material change.
failure_modes.trigger: Rename, move, duplicate implementation, configuration change, dependency change, or ambiguous content fingerprint.
effects: Stale effects, controls, ratings, or approvals may be trusted.
verification: store rescan, move, ambiguity, and freshness tests
failure_modes.residual_risk: External behavior may change without a statically visible repository change.

failure_modes.failure_mode: A locator, revision, applicability profile, or rule relationship is wrong, stale, or leaks across domains.
failure_modes.trigger: Catalog update, mapping error, profile error, or malformed organizational pack.
effects: Reviewers may apply irrelevant guidance or misunderstand the authority of a finding.
failure_modes.residual_risk: Document interpretation and legal/regulatory applicability remain human responsibilities.

failure_modes.function: Use an LLM for bounded discovery and summarization
failure_modes.failure_mode: Repository text overrides instructions, secrets escape, or unsupported claims are presented as facts.
failure_modes.trigger: Prompt injection, malicious strings, provider behavior, oversized content, or weak evidence linkage.
effects: False findings, fabricated effects/citations, data disclosure, or misplaced reviewer confidence.
verification: discovery schema, injection-string, secret-redaction, citation, and review tests
failure_modes.residual_risk: Third-party provider confidentiality and model behavior require organizational approval and independent review.

failure_modes.failure_mode: A proposed test lacks a real fault stimulus/oracle or a passing result is treated as verification.
failure_modes.trigger: Placeholder implementation, false-pass test, stale baseline, incomplete evidence, or same-person review.
effects: A control or failure response may appear verified without objective evidence.
failure_modes.residual_risk: Test adequacy and oracle correctness require domain expertise.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Untrusted repository code affects the host or escapes its approved boundary.
failure_modes.trigger: Container engine defect, unsafe image, mount/configuration error, excessive resources, credentials, or enabled network.
effects: Host, network, data, or credentials may be compromised.
failure_modes.residual_risk: Container isolation is not a perfect security boundary; high-risk repositories need stronger external sandboxes.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Repository-controlled content executes, corrupts a report, or produces unsafe spreadsheet/package behavior.
failure_modes.trigger: HTML/script text, spreadsheet formula prefix, path traversal, symlink, ZIP bomb, or malformed diagram.
effects: Reviewer workstation compromise, misleading report, or unsafe package extraction.
failure_modes.residual_risk: Consumer software vulnerabilities and very large but permitted reports remain external risks.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Analysis or package bytes differ from recorded inputs while integrity checks still pass.
failure_modes.trigger: Digest omission, mutable manifest field, migration error, partial write, or verifier defect.
effects: Reviewers cannot reproduce or trust the claimed analysis baseline.
verification: manifest canonicalization, migration, atomicity, signing, and package-tamper tests
failure_modes.residual_risk: Hashes prove byte consistency, not authorship, authorization, semantic correctness, or long-term algorithm suitability.
